name: Comme des Garçons Homme Plus x Nike Air Foamposite One SP 'Cat Eye'
story_html: The Comme des Garçons Homme Plus x Nike Air Foamposite One SP 'Cat Eye' celebrates the 2024 Summer Games with embossed circular patterns and a marbled finish in charcoal and off-white tones. In keeping with the Olympic theme, a webbing pull tab at the heel is marked with bronze, silver, and gold stripes. 'COMME des GARÇONS HOMME PLUS' is inscribed in white lettering on the black leather back tab. Underpinning the sneaker is a dark grey semi-translucent rubber outsole.
